Gorgog the Gronnslayer, born Gog, was the founder of the Gorian Empire. He broke the bodies of the gronn, opened their bones and ate their marrow to prove they were not gods, and raised up their skeletons so others could see his victory. He built his hall too large for any family to fill, and soon his home was an empire.

Gorgoa: River of Souls (written as Gorgoa, River of Souls in the Sanctum of Domination) bisects the mainland of the Maw from southwest to northeast . A protean force, Gorgoa represents all of the souls passing from Oribos to Torghast and is what the Soul Pillar becomes after it enters the Maw. Upon entering Torghast, Gorgoa continues flowing up through the Sanctum of Domination, whirling around the tower's central spire until it reaches its end at the Crown of Gorgoa just below the tower's peak. Good Things Come in Small Packages was a pet battle achievement earned by collecting 2000 unique pets. Reportedly, this achievement was removed as it was impossible to complete at the time, due to lack of unique pets in the game.
Good at Doings, Not Understandings is available after reaching Renown level 7 with the Maruuk Centaur.
__NOTOC__ Gordul Razamen is a centaur cooking trainer located in Teerakai in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Gooey Snailemental is obtained by combining 50 Leftover Elemental Slime.

Goopal is a rare elite rock snail that spawns at the Throughway in Zaralek Cavern.

Gorestained Hauberk drops from Goremaul the Gluttonous in Thaldraszus.

The Goodstitchs are a goblin family well trained in the art of tailoring. The known members can all be found in Booty Bay.

Gouge is a rogue class talent that incapacitates the target for a short period of time. Once a successful Gouge has been made, any damage will negate its incapacitation effect. Note that using Gouge will automatically turn off auto attacks.

When Illidan, Kael'thas, and Vashj undertook their campaign to close the Dimensional Gates that supported the demonic army of Magtheridon, they encountered two fel orc clans. Illidan closed the gates and his forces killed Mizgill and Gorgosh, who were engaged guarding the portals from Akama's rebels.

__NOTOC__ Gorlash is a sea giant wandering along the Wild Shore of the Cape of Stranglethorn. The giants of Stranglethorn Vale sank Captain Hecklebury Smotts' ship. Gorlash has been using Smotts' chest as a snuff box.
__NOTOC__ Grace of Earth is a trinket that reduces the user's threat to all mobs in a radius.
Gothik the Harvester is the second boss of the Military Quarter in Naxxramas. For his appearance in the starting area for the death knight class, see the Wrath of the Lich King section.

Gorn is an orc quest giver formerly located at Kargath in the Badlands. Since the Cataclysm he can be found in New Kargath.
Gorm Grimtotem was a tauren originally found in Thunder Bluff.

Gouging Pick can drop from many mobs and chests in the original vanilla zones of the Eastern Kingdoms and Kalimdor.
